# General Plastics

> Leading manufacturer of LAST-A-FOAM polyurethane foam solutions for aerospace, defense, marine, and industrial applications with custom fabrication capabilities.

General Plastics specializes in rigid and flexible polyurethane foam products, including proprietary LAST-A-FOAM formulations (FR-3700, FR-4500, FR-7100, R-3300, R-9300) for demanding industries. The company offers custom CNC machining, composite core manufacturing, and ISO 9001:2015/AS9100D certified production for aerospace, defense, and specialized applications.

## Key Topics

- LAST-A-FOAM polyurethane foam
- FR-3700 nuclear transport foam
- Aerospace and defense applications
- CNC machining and fabrication
- Composite core materials
- HDU foam signage
- Subsea buoyancy foam
- Dielectric materials
- Blast mitigation systems
- Thermal insulation blocks
- Medical-grade foam
- ITAR compliance
- AS9100D certification
- Rapid prototyping
- Custom polyurethane manufacturing
